species.real: The Stiperstones are quartzite tors shattered by frost at the end of the last Ice Age, when Shropshire sat at the edge of the ice.
species.name: Diaboulder

dex.text: Sits on the Stiperstones when the mist is down, as heavy as the hill and twice as patient. It is waiting for the stones to sink. They have not sunk yet.
dex.fact: Legend says the Devil spilled the Stiperstones' rocks from his apron, and that when mist covers the Devil's Chair, he is sitting in it.
